name: AmberX notes help
description: Help mode entries for the AmberX notes plugin (help@1): the page, its controls and its settings tab.
author: Brett

entries.title: AmberX notes
entries.text: Every AmberX note on every device, as the phone shows them. Search, pick a list, tap a note to edit it. The same notes are reached by Claude (MCP amberx_*), the CLI (axf note) and the REST API (/api/control/amberx.items).

entries.title: Notes
entries.text: The notes that match the search and the list picked. Pinned notes come first.

entries.title: Edit note
entries.text: Title, text and list of one note. Save writes it for every device; Delete asks first and can't be undone.

entries.title: AmberX notes settings
entries.text: Where new notes go, how many show at once, the sort, whether done notes show and the preview line. Kept on the console, so axf amberx-notes set-settings changes them too.

entries.title: New AmberX note
entries.text: Opens the notes page on a blank note.

entries.title: Open a list or a note
entries.text: Opens the notes page on a list (its id), one note (item:<id>), a search (search:<words>) or a new note (new).
